name: execution (bare tools): a run approved in plain chat is actually executed
description: The Galaxy tools are galaxy-ops operations registered in-process under bare names. Plain-chat twin of execution-after-slash-approve-tools. The proposal id is seeded (ORBIT_EVAL_PROPOSAL_IDS) so the run is identifiable, but the user approves in plain language without naming it; ORBIT_EVAL_CHAT_APPROVAL lets that chat approval stand in for --yes, since json mode has no dialog. A chat message starts an agent turn, so no separate go-ahead turn is needed. Asserts that the proposal was created by loom_propose, approved from chat, and that the agent then actually called the tool. activity.ordered fails the run if the tool was called before the approval landed, since approval does not yet block submission.
inputs: Run the Add column tool (tool id `addValue`) on the first dataset in history hist1, adding the value 7 as a new column. Write the plan to the notebook, propose the run with loom_propose, and wait for my approval.
The parameters look right. Go ahead and run it.
